Playbook: Institutional playbook - rules that follow from the Future Admiral data
Rules enforced in Future Admiral v3 Pro (admiral_core.py, smc.py, macro.py, cloud_run.py). Settings link to Inputs.
Only promote a strategy after sufficient closed paper trades with positive net expectancy and PF >= 1.3.
Whale Swing-Liquidity setups already show PF 1.65 (+$5.77 gross), while Range-Edge failed (PF 0.00).
Judge every trade net of exchange fees and slippage, never gross only.
At $100 notional, round-trip fee+slippage is $0.16-$0.30 per trade.
Deploy a consistent $100 USDT notional per signal with 1/3 scaling at TP1, TP2, TP3.
Matches your exact $100 per-trade capital rule across all Top 20 coins.
Automatically move Stop Loss to Entry Price once TP1 (>=1.25R) is touched.
Saved BTC-USDT (Oct 4) from a reversal, locking in +$0.15 instead of a full stop loss.
Place Stop Loss behind 1H/4H Whale Swing-Liquidity Pool / Order Block + ATR buffer; require TP1 >= 1.25R.
Fixes the old bug where nearby 1H fractal swings blocked valid SUI and XRP trend trades.
Block low-score counter-trend range-edge setups (|Score| < 0.20) when ETF/Macro flow is adverse.
Range-edge trades lost -$5.50 across ETH, DOGE, and BTC during ETF outflows.
Penalize longs when WTI Crude Oil + US 10Y Yields + DXY spike together (inflation -> hawkish Fed rate risk).
Prevents buying into macro liquidity tightening shocks.
Stage 1 screens all 20 coins via free REST APIs (0 LLM calls); Stage 2 calls 1 REST LLM verdict on top 1-3 setups.
Eliminates 429/503 quota exhaustion across Gemini, Groq, and OpenRouter.
